title: One Design Studio Selections File per Purchase Agreement
content:
Each purchase agreement carries at most one Design Studio Selections file at a time; a second file on the same agreement is opened only after the first is cancelled.

**Condition for opening a file.** A file is opened only for a purchase agreement that has no other design studio file in a status other than cancelled.

- *Whose record decides:* the design studio file records held by Calloway for that purchase agreement, as they stand before the file is opened. A buyer's account of earlier files does not replace those records.
- *Which records count:* only files linked to the same purchase agreement. Files on the buyer's other agreements do not bear on this condition.
- *Statuses that block a new file:* awaiting appointment, in selection, structural closed, finalized and delivered. Only a cancelled file leaves the agreement free for a new one.

**Status of the existing file on the same agreement, and the result**

| Existing file on the agreement | A new file may be opened |
|---|---|
| None | Yes |
| Cancelled | Yes |
| Awaiting appointment | No |
| In selection | No |
| Structural closed | No |
| Finalized | No |
| Delivered | No |

*Hypothetical case:* an agreement's first Design Studio Selections file was cancelled; a second file may then be opened for that agreement. Had the first file still stood in selection, no second file would be opened for it.
